recent.text: Pelicans center Yves Missi was re-evaluated yesterday by team physicians for his left knee bone bruise. The re-evaluation indicated that Missi continues to make good progress with his recovery. He has been cleared to resume on-court activities and will participate in practice
recent.author: New Orleans Pelicans

recent.text: #Pelicans starting center Yves Missi on his timetable to return (he hasn't played since Oct. 23 due to knee injury): "It's undecided. I'm getting better, getting back in shape, especially game shape... (not playing) has been super frustrating, but I'm trying to cheer for my guys"
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Jamahl Mosley says Yves Missi will be listed as day-to-day. Pelicans want to see how his body responds to today’s activity tomorrow.
